physDesc.physMedium: Bound in cardboard cover with marbled sides and cloth spine. In lower left-hand corner of the front cover a printed label inscribed: "Musikforeningens Archiv. / Partitur", which has been deleted in pencil. In the middle a handwritten label in Gade's hand: "Die heilige Nacht." and in upper left-hand corner another handwritten label inscribed: "Die heilige Nacht / op. 40." Written in ink. Paper: 20 staves. Paginated 2-48 in Gade's hand. At the end of the music: Gade's musical signature and "1861". Two last pages blank.
